data.title: 史尔特尔 · 甜品店的口味选择
data.description: 街角甜品店里，史尔特尔穿着灰色卫衣与炭灰百褶裙，斜挎小包，站在冰淇淋展示柜前逐一看着口味牌。她一手扶住包带，另一手指向香草口味，语气比平时耐心得多——「就这个。别把旁边的坚果混进去，我要先尝原来的味道。」
data.action: 站在展示柜前，一手扶包带，另一手指向香草口味牌
data.promptProse: Surtr points to vanilla at the ice-cream counter while holding her bag strap in afternoon window light.
data.camera: medium shot, side view of the display case and the pointing hand
data.animaCaption: One hand holds her bag strap while the other points toward vanilla at the display counter.
